scenes.setting: Home at noon: the new maid Bella caught reading the newspaper; Klein grants her lamp and old papers, and orders a small celebration tea
scenes.text_anchor: After leaving Azik's house, Klein took a public carriage back to Daffodil Street.

scenes.setting: Locked bedroom: careful Cogitation over the new potion — Old Neil's end has made 'losing control' terrifyingly real
scenes.text_anchor: After locking the door to his room, Klein sat on the edge of his bed

scenes.setting: Gawain's training field: six months of knight progress in forty minutes — the teacher doesn't ask why, just adds weapons training
scenes.text_anchor: Three in the afternoon, on a crude training field.

scenes.setting: Dunn's office on Sunday: promotion to inspector and a raise to ten pounds a week — Backlund-bungalow math ensues

scenes.setting: Chanis Gate duty: Dunn brings a case — parliamentary representative Maynard found dead; a mediumship ritual is needed
